CustomField.description: THE VENDOR ROW THIS PROJECTED INTO, written by the writer at the instant it lands and never reconstructed. It is what stops a second pass writing the criterion again: ALTF__Decision_Criteria__c carries no external id to upsert against, so the only record that we already wrote one is the one we keep. A watermark is written by the writer or it does not exist.
CustomField.label: Projected Criterion Id
